summary: Treat OIDC sub as opaque and authorize it only through a pre-provisioned issuer, tenant, and subject digest binding to an active internal owner.
invariants: External subjects are never parsed as internal UUID authority
Bindings are issuer-and-tenant scoped and store only subject digests
Missing or conflicting provisioning fails closed
forbidden: Just-in-time owner creation from an OIDC claim
Cross-issuer or cross-tenant subject reuse without an explicit binding
